name: Audio track
summary: One row of an audio track list: a preview play and pause button, the file name, its duration and a check when selected; a click on the row selects it.
highlights: Preview play and pause, file name, duration and a selected check
The row plays nothing itself: it emits play, pause and select
Selected rows take the Vivid Pink 5% tint, like a Menu item
lead: ONE custom element, <aha-audio-track>, for listing existing audio tracks to choose from (the audio upload modal's Existing tracks tab). A tertiary icon-only <aha-button> previews the track, then the file name on one line, its duration and a pink check when selected. A click anywhere on the row but the preview button selects it. The row holds no audio: the preview button toggles `playing` and emits `play` or `pause`, and the consumer plays the file, keeps one row playing at a time and clears `selected` on the other rows. Stack rows in a column with no gap; for a picker without previews, a selectable <aha-list> is enough.
codeNote: Attributes: track-title (the file name), duration (seconds; shown as m:ss, hidden when absent), selected, playing, play-label (default "Play preview") and pause-label ("Pause preview"), each followed by ": <track-title>" in the button's accessible name. Properties: trackTitle, selected, playing. Events (composed, bubbling, detail { trackTitle }): play and pause from the preview button (it has already toggled `playing`), select from a click elsewhere on the row (it has already set `selected`). The select target is a native button with aria-pressed, so Tab reaches the preview and then the row, and Enter or Space selects. One row playing and one selected at a time are the consumer's job: on play remove `playing` from the other rows and pause their audio; on the audio's ended remove `playing`; on select remove `selected` from the others. React 18: listen with ref.current.addEventListener; Vue binds it natively (@play, @pause, @select). Vue 2 apps import '@ahaslides-product/design/aha-audio-track' and add aha-audio-track to the app's list of DS elements.

spec.label: Row
spec.value: 44px minimum height, padding 8, radius 8, white; #F7F7F7 (bg-hover) on hover; selected #E70E68 at 5% (bg-accent), the Menu's selected tint, also on hover

spec.label: Preview
spec.value: tertiary icon-only sm Button (28px): system-play, system-pause while `playing`

spec.label: Name
spec.value: 14/22 #1A1A1A, one line with an ellipsis, regular; semibold when selected

spec.label: Check
spec.value: system-check 16 in #E70E68 (icon-active), shown when selected, so the state is not colour alone

spec.label: Focus
spec.value: keyboard focus on the row's select button draws a 2px #E70E68 outline (border-focus)

props.name: track-title
props.desc: The file name or track title

props.name: duration
props.desc: The track's length, shown as m:ss; hidden when absent

props.name: selected
props.desc: The chosen track: tint, semibold name, check and aria-pressed="true"

props.name: playing
props.desc: The preview is playing: the preview button shows pause

props.name: play-label / pause-label
props.desc: The preview button's accessible name for translation; the track title is appended

props.name: play / pause
props.desc: Composed and bubbling; the preview button was pressed and `playing` has toggled. The consumer plays or pauses the audio

props.name: select
props.desc: Composed and bubbling; the row was clicked or its select button pressed, and `selected` is set
